   - The last byte contains the number of hash functions (k) used

2. To check if a key may match:
   - Extract k (number of hash functions) from the last byte of bloom_filter
   - If k > 30, return true (reserved for future encodings)
   - Compute the hash of the key using BloomHash
   - Use double-hashing: generate a sequence of hash values by adding a delta to the initial hash
   - For each of the k hash values, check if the corresponding bit is set in the bit array
   - If any bit is not set, return false (key definitely doesn't exist)
   - If all bits are set, return true (key may exist - false positives are possible)
